_source: First real field-map for RTL-024's ARINC RX adapter (ARCH-BUS-001) as a reggen consumer. Covers ONLY ARX_CONTROL (REG-1000), whose 5 real fields are confirmed, by direct read of RCA-DFC-ARCH-002.md's dedicated dfc_rtl024_arinc_rx_adapter_control_t Appendix B table, to occupy that struct's entire 5-bit width exactly (reggen.py v5 requires a field-map's control_registers to cover its consumer struct's FULL declared width -- confirmed directly via a real failed run against the original plan of reusing the general-purpose 278-bit dfc_rtl024_control_t, which carries ~270 unrelated host/test/clock-reset/buffer-clear fields no single field-map for this narrow scope should need to map). Those 5 fields were migrated out of dfc_rtl024_control_t into this dedicated struct for exactly that reason (see dfc_rtl024_control_t's own reserved_arx_control_migrated placeholder and dfc_rtl024_arinc_rx_adapter_control_t's own header note). ARX_CONTROL's readback class is 'internal_reg' (confirmed via tools/pkggen/dfc_registers_pkg.json) -- the regbank already stores/returns its own written value generically, so no status_registers entry is needed; dfc_rtl024_arinc_rx_adapter_status_t is a 1-bit reserved placeholder purely to satisfy reggen.py's named-status-struct requirement (no real adapter status field exists yet), consistent with that struct's own disclosed header note -- deliberately not claimed by any status_registers entry here.
